lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: OMG

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Words can't describe my joy.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: The moment I held this fishing rod in my hands,

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: the feeling was unlike anything I'd ever experienced.
Do you like it?

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Like it? I love it!

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Laying there sullenly in my bathtub,

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I could feel my fishing aspirations waning.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: But now that yearning has been reignited!

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I've made up my mind.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: If this feeling, this electricity coursing through my veins,

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: comes from merely holding a fishing rod,

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: then I will give my life to achieving my dream of going fishing.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I shall pore through the archives and locate a suitable fishing hole up on the surface.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: When that day comes, I will call upon you once again.
Okay.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: You've turned what seemed like an impossible dream into a reality.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I cannot thank you enough.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: For now, I must move onto larger waters.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I shall practice in the Ark's swimming pool!
